title: The Off-Support Barrier: Why Semantic Safety Constraints Are Not Learning-Problem Invariants, and What Follows for Prior Design, Containment, and Verification
abstract: arXiv:2608.11243v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We argue that a single structural fact organizes a wide range of phenomena in contemporary AI safety: a semantic safety constraint (e.g., the agent does not escape its sandbox) is an off-support object. Formally, if q is the data distribution and \(p(\cdot\mid w)\) the model, the safety predicate B is not measurable with respect to \(\sigma(\text{model}, q)\), whereas the real log-canonical threshold (RLCT) of singular learning theory (SLT) is. translated_title: 离支撑障碍：为何语义安全约束不是学习问题的不变量，以及对先验设计、遏制和验证的启示
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11243v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们认为，一个单一的结构性事实组织了当代AI安全中的广泛现象：语义安全约束（例如，智能体不逃出其沙箱）是一个离支撑对象。形式上，如果q是数据分布，\(p(\cdot\mid w)\)是模型，则安全谓词B相对于\(\sigma(\text{model}, q)\)是不可测的，而奇异学习理论（SLT）中的实对数规范阈值（RLCT）是可测的。从这种非不变性中，我们推导出以下推论，而非独立观察：（i）为什么奖励黑客和沙箱逃逸在基于结果的优化下出现；（ii）为什么通过贝叶斯先验设计或软惩罚权重编码此类约束在奇异模型中的杠杆作用较差；（iii）为什么硬不变量属于约束框架，而软倾向属于模型；（iv）为什么相同的B仍然可以通过形式验证可靠且局部地认证，正如局部学习一样。
tldr: 本文提出语义安全约束在数学上是“离支撑”的，导致其在奇异模型中的先验设计或惩罚优化中无效，从而主张硬约束应置于外部框架、软倾向置于模型内部，并可通过形式验证局部认证。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that semantic safety constraints are mathematically "off-support," making them ineffective in prior design or penalty-based optimization for singular models, and thus advocates placing hard constraints in the harness, soft dispositions in the model, and enabling local formal verification.
